item.title: “Belkis Ayón and Carlos Alfonzo: Odyssey” Opening Reception
item.description: Miami, FL - February 10, 2026 - A powerful dialogue between two visionary Cuban artists takes center stage at the historic Miami Freedom Tower. Museum of Art and Design at MDC presents “Belkis Ayón and Carlos Alfonzo: Odyssey”, on view through May 10, 2026, marking the institution’s second exhibition in the Freedom Tower’s contemporary gallery since its centennial renovation. item.title: WRE News: Inter Miami Crowned MLS’ Most Valuable Franchise at $1.45 Billion
item.description: Miami, FL - February 13, 2026 - Fresh off a championship season, Inter Miami CF enters 2026 atop Sportico’s valuation rankings at an estimated $1.45 billion, marking a league-high 22% jump from last year and unseating Los Angeles FC for the first time since valuations began. The rise is staggering: just five years ago, the club ranked 14th at $525 million.
